endpoint: Change from baseline in pre-bronchodilator FEV1 at each post-randomization visit (52 wk)
response: Change from baseline in pre-BD FEV1 (mL)
fixed_effects: treatment, baseline pre-BD FEV1, age, sex, smoking status, concomitant LABA, country, time, time x treatment [StatR p.10]
fixed_effects_std: treatment; visit/time; baseline; region/country/site
covariance: UN (\"The default analysis above was to employ restricted maximum likelihood (REML) with an unstructured covariance matrix\") [StatR p.10]
covariance_fallback: ML+UN, then CS+REML, then CS+ML; then drop covariates in order country, LABA, smoking status, sex [StatR p.10]
time_coding: categorical time with time x treatment
estimand_contrast: Significance declared on two-sided unadjusted p at last measurement; Applicant's LS means were 'overall' effects computed by truncating later visits
missing_data: no replacement of missing values (MAR implicit); supplementary LOCF ANCOVA
result: End-of-treatment diff (mL): M2-124 39 (N rand 745/745), M2-125 58 (730/766), both p<0.001. Reviewer timepoint-specific Week 52: 124 diff 39 (p=0.015); 125 diff 44 (p<.001) [StatR Tables 5,7]
fda_comments: Reviewer: Applicant's repeated-measures LS means did not use the time x treatment interaction — they deleted later visits and estimated an overall effect through each week, which 'does not provide an estimate for particular timepoint'; reviewer re-estimated using the interaction term (Table 7) [StatR p.20-21]
